setup_bundles_intro_unlimited: Choose the features to install. You can change them later from the bundle catalogue.
setup_bundles_wait: Downloading can take a few moments per bundle.

setup_bundles_unknown: One of the chosen bundles is not in the catalogue.
setup_q_intro: Tick a few boxes: we suggest the matching bundles, which you can adjust afterwards. The first answers are the highest priority.
setup_q_manual: Choose myself from the full list
setup_q_timeclock: Do your employees clock their hours?

setup_q_timeoff: Do you manage leave and absences?
setup_q_timeoff_hint: Requests, manager approval, absences visible in the schedule.
setup_q_exchange: Can employees swap or pick up shifts?

setup_q_daily: Do you want an end-of-day report (sales, notes)?
setup_q_daily_hint: Entered by the manager, approval, sales statistics.
setup_q_planning: Do you want tomorrow's schedule approved before it is sent to the boss?

setup_q_messaging_hint: Conversations between employees and managers, without leaving Kintai.
setup_q_notebook: Do you want a shared team notebook?
setup_q_notebook_hint: Shared instructions and information, shown on the dashboard.
setup_q_directory: Do you want a team directory?
setup_q_directory_hint: Colleagues' profiles within a store, contact details shared by choice.
setup_q_photos: Do you need store photos (displays, compliance)?
setup_q_photos_hint: Dated photos per store, with limited retention.
setup_q_hr: Do you track hiring, resignations and a payroll estimate?
setup_q_hr_hint: HR reports and a salary estimate from the hours worked.

setup_done_failed: These bundles could not be installed; you can try again from the catalogue:
setup_pending_banner: Kintai setup is not finished (organisation, store, e-mail, notifications, operations, bundles, license).
setup_recap_intro: Here is where the setup stands. Each line opens its step; everything can be changed later from the settings.
setup_finish_hint: The setup banner goes away; skipped steps can still be done from the settings.
setup_org_intro: Your organisation's name appears under "Kintai" and on the sign-in page.
setup_org_name_hint: Also used to name the employees' external calendar.

setup_org_public_url_forced: Set by the server environment: not editable here.

setup_mail_from_invalid: The from address is not valid.

setup_notif_intro: These are the channels Kintai can use to notify your teams. The bell always works; the others depend on the setup.
setup_notif_email_ko: not configured: see the E-mail step and the public address
setup_ops_intro: Backups, updates and scheduled tasks: what keeps the instance healthy.
setup_ops_backup_keep_hint: 0 = all. The oldest are deleted beyond that.
setup_ops_channel_hint: Applies to Kintai and its bundles.
setup_ops_cron_intro: Backups, purges and system alerts are scheduled tasks. Run them every hour from your host's scheduler:

audit_activity_log_manual_purged: Activity log purged by the Owner

privacy_contact_body: For any questions regarding data protection, contact the administrator of your Kintai instance.
privacy_cookies_body: Kintai uses session cookies that are strictly necessary for the application to function (authentication, user session). No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy_data_collected_body: Kintai collects the following data: last name, first name, email address, employee code, work schedules, clock-in/out records, leave requests, and user preferences. This data is necessary for managing schedules and human resources.
privacy_legal_basis_body: Data processing is based on the performance of the employment contract and the employer's legitimate interest in organizing and managing schedules.
privacy_policy_intro: Read our privacy policy to understand how your data is collected and processed.
privacy_recipients_body: Data is accessible only to authorized administrators and managers of the organization. It is not shared with third parties without explicit consent.
privacy_retention_body: Data is retained for the duration of the contractual relationship, then archived in accordance with legal obligations (5 years for payroll data).
privacy_rights_access: Right of access — obtain a copy of your data
privacy_rights_erasure: Right to erasure — request the deletion of your data
privacy_rights_intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy_rights_objection: Right to object — object to the processing of your data
privacy_rights_outro: To exercise your rights, contact your organization's administrator.
privacy_rights_portability: Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured format
privacy_rights_rectification: Right to rectification — correct your inaccurate data
privacy_security_body: Data is transmitted via HTTPS and stored on secure servers. Access to data is protected by authentication and role-based access control.

public_url_hint: Full address users open Kintai with, including https:// and any sub-folder (e.g. https://kintai.example.com). Used for the links in emails, such as password reset.

notif_calendar_sync_error_body: Kintai no longer has access to your Google Calendar (access revoked or expired). Reconnect your account in the Calendars tab of your profile to resume syncing.
gcal_intro: Link your Google account so that your shifts and approved leave appear in a dedicated calendar and update themselves within moments whenever the schedule changes.
gcal_privacy_note: Kintai only accesses the calendar it creates itself: your other calendars are neither read nor changed. Sync goes from Kintai to Google only; editing an event in Google does not change the schedule.
gcal_disconnect_delete_events: Also delete Kintai events from my calendar
gcal_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Google Calendar? The schedule will no longer be synced.
gcal_revoked_notice: Kintai no longer has access to your Google Calendar (access revoked, token expired). Reconnect your account to resume syncing.
gcal_not_available: Google Calendar linking is not enabled on this instance.
gcal_state_invalid: The connection request has expired or is not valid. Start again from your profile.
gcal_denied: Authorisation denied: Google Calendar was not connected.
gcal_connect_failed: Google refused the connection. Try again, or tell the administrator if the problem persists.
gcal_connected: Google Calendar connected. Your shifts will appear in the calendar within moments.
gcal_options_saved: Calendar name saved; it will be updated at the next sync.
gcal_admin_intro: Let your employees link their Google Calendar. Each instance creates its own project in the Google Cloud console (OAuth client of type "Web application", Google Calendar API enabled) and enters its client ID and secret here.
gcal_admin_enable_hint: Once enabled, every user can link their calendar from their profile (iCal tab).
gcal_admin_secret_kept: Secret saved (leave empty to keep it)
gcal_admin_secret_hint: Encrypted in the database; it is never shown again nor written to the logs.
gcal_admin_redirect_hint: Copy as-is into the OAuth client's "Authorised redirect URIs" in the Google Cloud console.
gcal_admin_cron_hint: Automatic updates are handled by the "calendar-sync" scheduled task: schedule it every minute (see the scheduled tasks documentation).
gcal_admin_test_mode_warning: While the Google project stays in "Testing" mode, tokens expire after 7 days and only declared testers can connect: publish the consent screen for lasting use.
gcal_admin_check_ok: Google accepts the client ID and secret.
gcal_admin_check_invalid: Google rejects the client ID or secret: check them in the Google Cloud console.
gcal_admin_check_unreachable: Google cannot be reached from this server (network, firewall, curl extension).
gcal_admin_check_incomplete: Enter and save the client ID and secret before testing.
notif_admin_retention_hint: Older read notifications are deleted by the "notification-purge" scheduled task (minimum :min days). An unread notification is never deleted.
notif_admin_bell_detail: Always on: it keeps the history and cannot be turned off.
notif_admin_web_no_keys: Encryption keys missing: regenerate them below.
notif_admin_email_not_configured: Email sending is not set up (see MAIL_* in .env, and the email test page).
notif_admin_email_no_url: Public URL of the instance missing: links in an email must be absolute (see Settings › Public URL).
notif_admin_mobile_disabled: Disabled (PUSH_FCM_ENABLED). Only used by the mobile app.
notif_admin_mobile_incomplete: Project ID or service account file missing (see config/push.php).
notif_admin_test_intro: Sends you a test notification through every active channel, ignoring your preferences and quiet hours.
notif_admin_vapid_intro: The keys are created automatically. Regenerating them invalidates every current subscription: each browser will subscribe again on its next visit, otherwise it receives nothing.

notif_prefs_intro: For each type, choose what you receive outside the bell. The bell always receives everything: it keeps the history.
notif_quiet_intro: During these hours push notifications arrive without sound or vibration (depending on your browser or device) and nothing is held back. E-mails are sent as usual.
notif_quiet_bell_note: The bell is never muted. Instance time; the range may cross midnight (e.g. 22:00 → 07:00).
notif_quiet_invalid: Invalid quiet hours: give a start and an end that differ (HH:MM).

push_not_configured: Push notifications are not available on this instance (missing encryption keys or PHP extension). Contact the administrator.
push_ios_install_required: On iPhone and iPad, push notifications require installing Kintai on the home screen (Share › Add to Home Screen), then opening it from that icon (iOS 16.4 or later).
push_activation_failed: Activation failed. Try again in a moment; if the problem persists, tell the administrator.
validation_push_subscription_invalid: Invalid push subscription: wrong address or keys.

reset_data_confirm: All operational data (schedules, timeclocks, time off, reports, messages...) will be permanently deleted. A backup will be created and downloaded first. Continue?

reset_factory_confirm: EVERYTHING will be deleted, including your account and the installation itself: the application will go back to its very first launch state and the web installer will need to be redone entirely. A backup will be created and downloaded first. This action is irreversible. Continue?
reset_factory_hint: Also deletes your account and the installation: the application goes back to its first-launch state, the web installer will need to be redone.
reset_factory_summary: The entire application will be reset to its original state, including your Owner account: you will be logged out and redirected to the web installer.
reset_intro: Resets the application. A full backup is always created and offered for download before any deletion.
reset_keep_label: Also keep (everything is deleted by default):
reset_keep_shift_types_hint: Keeps shift types (Morning, Evening...) and per-employee hourly rates.
reset_keep_stores_hint: Keeps stores, their members, and their settings (deductions, import).
